items.title: Prove and repair stale-refresh execution fan-out
items.context: Probe rp-mtlq4b1z-hem77a and review rr-mtlq63zn-umve6e prove that selector is currently part of the subprocess execution key. A committed pre-fix test must first fail on the real handler with the measured B-fe8f-shaped count, and red_evidence_create must bind that failing command and baseline commit before any production fix. The same unchanged test command must then pass after the fan-out implementation.
items.userSees: A tool-owned RED record points to a committed baseline where the 71-intent/two-command fixture fails because execution count is greater than 2; after a distinct GREEN commit the same command reports exactly two subprocess executions and 71 independently evaluated intent receipts.
excludes: Persistent reuse across different repository states
Changing the selector pin mutation policy

happy.desc: A committed pre-fix fixture records RED with 71 unique selectors over two commands and measured execution count greater than 2; after a distinct production commit the unchanged command turns GREEN with execution count exactly 2 and all matching intents mechanical.

edge.desc: From one successful shared execution, one absent selector demotes only its own intent while sibling selectors receive passing receipts.

adversarial.desc: A non-zero or timed-out shared execution cannot mint a pass for any assertion that references it.

items.title: Separate immutable execution receipts from per-intent assertion receipts
items.context: The current VerificationExecutionReceipt embeds selectorMatched and cannot safely represent one execution feeding distinct selectors. Introduce versioned execution and assertion identities with legacy fail-closed compatibility.
items.userSees: Each verifier execution has one immutable execution receipt and output artifact, while every intent has its own assertion receipt bound to its immutable selector and the shared execution digest.
excludes: Changing manual/docs evidence into executable proof

happy.desc: Multiple intent assertions reference one execution receipt and independently bind intentRef, selector, matcher version, output digest, and result.

edge.desc: Legacy combined receipts remain readable but cannot be silently promoted into reusable split receipts.

adversarial.desc: Tampering with the execution, selector, assertion, or output artifact invalidates the affected evidence fail closed.

items.title: Authorize input-scoped reuse only for mechanically complete verifier closures
items.context: Replace all-or-nothing stale re-execution with evidenceInputDigest decisions only when dependency closure, environment, toolchain, command, cwd, timeout, and capture semantics are complete and unchanged; otherwise retain strict material/story hash invalidation.
items.userSees: An unrelated file change launches zero verifier subprocesses and emits an auditable reuse receipt only when the complete verifier input closure is unchanged; uncertain inputs trigger a real rerun.
excludes: Observed-read traces treated as complete without enforcement
Skipping side-effectful commands whose outputs are required downstream

happy.desc: Unrelated file drift with an unchanged mechanically complete input closure performs zero executions and writes a reuse receipt referencing the immutable prior execution.

edge.desc: When only one of two verifier input digests changes, only that command executes once and the other receives a reuse decision.

adversarial.desc: Missing, partial, dynamic, networked, side-effectful, or changed-during-run inputs prohibit reuse and force a real command execution.

items.title: Wire the new evidence facts into lifecycle gates and contract verification
items.context: Execution, assertion, reuse, dependency completeness, and artifact integrity are gate-consumed process facts. Update registry semantics, migration diagnostics, documentation, and regression coverage so narrative claims cannot bypass runtime enforcement.
items.userSees: Lifecycle validation reports the execution/assertion/reuse evidence state and rejects malformed, stale, incomplete, or tampered records while accepting current split evidence.
excludes: Unrelated reviewer or DONE gate redesign
Manual version bump outside automatic DONE effects

happy.desc: Lifecycle gates consume valid split and reuse evidence and the process-fact contract verifier recognizes every new fact.

edge.desc: Legacy or incomplete records produce explicit diagnostics and retain strict fallback rather than disappearing or being silently rebound.

adversarial.desc: Narrative pass text or caller-authored hashes, signatures, and receipts cannot satisfy the new gate facts.
